headline: Coalition Reports Houthi Drone Strike Targeting Riyadh Financial District
summary: A coalition military spokesperson confirmed that a drone launched by Houthi forces targeted a building in the King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh.
why: Riyadh is Saudi Arabia's financial hub, and security threats against corporate infrastructure introduce geopolitical risk premiums to regional assets.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Cross-border attacks on commercial architecture increase security concerns for business operations.
